name: Kiino Doukyuu
source:
A User that Chris brought along. He was originally a User under Son Faction's facilities, moving from places to places. He does not yet have any actual abilities, nor does he show any interest in combats. 
He was once in the same facility as Takaya and Yashiro, so he at least recognizes them when they meet.
translation:
A User that Chris brought along. He was originally a User under Son Faction's facilities, moving from places to places. He does not yet have any actual abilities, nor does he show any interest in combats. 
He was once in the same facility as Takaya and Yashiro, so he at least recognizes them when they meet.
